about.en: CLAUDIA is the Solana token of Claudia, an AI influencer character and the platform built around it at useclaudia.xyz, which posts memecoin-market commentary on X as @claudia_onchain and offers a Solana trading terminal plus tooling for building AI agents. The token is the SPL mint 2j5SaS7xy776qCBpyPQbZjyQSAtKiFgrwjfErthnW2ZM, whose on-chain metadata carries the name Claudia and the symbol CLAUDIA, with 6 decimals and a supply of about 946.2 million.
